Jinyang Jiang

I am a postdoctoral fellow in the Department of Data and Systems Engineering at the University of Hong Kong, working under the supervision of Prof. Zuo-Jun (Max) Shen and Prof. Shaochong Lin. I completed my Ph.D. at Peking University, where Prof. Yijie Peng was my doctoral advisor. I received my B.S. and B.Eng. from Wuhan University.

My research focuses on stochastic optimization and reinforcement learning. From Atari games to large language models, I study how AI can learn more from each interaction and make better decisions in an uncertain world.
